adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the logic. Looking at lines 1060-1066 in handleNewBooking.ts, the destinationCalendar is set to null when neither eventType.destinationCalendar nor organizerUser.destinationCalendar exists. Then at lines 1073-1075, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` which uses optional chaining - if destinationCalendar is null, the push is a no-op. For collective team events where only non-organizer hosts have destination calendars configured (but not the organizer or event type), teamDestinationCalendars would be populated but never added to evt because the base array is null. The fix should initialize to an empty array `[]` instead of `null` to allow the push to work.
